# Basketful

> Basketful is a demo grocery delivery site. Shoppers pick a store, fill a cart, choose a delivery window, and place an order. Nothing is really charged or delivered.

The whole shopping journey is exposed to browser agents as WebMCP tools on `document.modelContext`, so an agent can shop without reading or clicking the DOM.

## Tools available on every page

- choose_store: open a store (Greenleaf Market, Harbor Foods Co-op, Penny Pantry)
- search_products: search or browse the open store's catalog
- add_to_cart: add a list of products by name
- update_cart_item: change a quantity or remove a product
- get_cart: read the cart, fees, and order minimum
- start_checkout: go to the checkout page
- get_order_status: check on a placed order

## Tools available on the checkout page

- set_delivery_address: a form for the delivery address
- set_delivery_options: delivery window, tip, and out-of-stock preference
- place_order: places the order; confirm with the shopper first

## Pages

- [Stores](/): choose a store
- [Orders](/orders): past orders and live tracking
